title: Grand Opening of Villa Serena II
description:
Join us life for the grand opening of Villa Serena II, the newest affordable housing to open in San Marcos. Villa Serena II is located at 339 Marcos Street and features 63 apartments for low-income families at or below 60% of the area median income.
